d:
In this video, we show you the step-by-step process to connect Android Auto in your Tata Nexon. Whether you have a manual or automatic transmission, the process is the same. With Android Auto, you can use Google Maps, play music, check calls, send messages, and more – directly on your car’s infotainment screen.
What’s Covered in this Video:
Android Auto connection requirements
Cable setup & USB port location in Tata Nexon
Connecting your Android phone to the infotainment system
Enabling Android Auto for the first time
Using Google Maps, Music, Podcasts, and Calls via Android Auto
